answer_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS average_price_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue_usd,

  COUNT(*) AS sales_lines,
  MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date,
  MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line

sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: One row, one figure, read off the result: the average price a customer actually paid for one article is 310.98 USD — 218,814,471.66 USD charged after discount, divided by the 703,621 units that money bought, across 223,974 sales lines from the first order on 2016-05-18 to the last on 2025-12-31. It is units-weighted, so a product that shifted in volume pulls it harder than one that sold once. What it is NOT: not the average price on the shelf (the catalogue price averaged once per product over all 2,517 products is 356.83 — higher, because it counts a product nobody bought equally with one that sold ten thousand times); not the price before discount (330.58 per article); not per category, brand, channel or year; and not narrowed to either channel — the web shop and the physical shops are both in it.

value: Every one of the 223,974 rows of contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line — no restriction applied, no row excluded, as the returned `sales_lines` count confirms. No channel predicate, because `store.resolution.the_channel_is_the_location_sentinel` scopes its `physical` default with `applies: subject` and the subject here is a measure, not a Store; both the web shop and the 57 trading shops are in. No date predicate, by `order.default.an_unscoped_question_covers_all_time` — the returned window is order_date 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31, the full extent. The denominator is the 703,621 units sold, not a row count and not a product count. The 2,517 rows of dim_product are NOT the population: this is per article SOLD, not per article offered, so products that never sold contribute nothing.

turns.did:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_product
  ) AS products,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_product
  ) AS avg_catalogue_list_price,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS sales_lines,
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(quantity)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS units_sold,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS x
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS net_price_per_article,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(SUM(gross_amount) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS x
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS gross_price_per_article,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(net_price), 2)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS avg_line_net_price,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS avg_line_unit_price
